t.zh: <level-ref to="1A2"></level-ref>用的是坐标 (x, y)，程序里读像素用的却是数组下标 I[第几行, 第几列]。两种写法说的是同一批像素，顺序不一样。
t.en: <level-ref to="1A2"></level-ref> used coordinates (x, y), but a program reads a pixel by its array index I[row, column]. The two name the same pixels in a different order.

t.zh: 这一关新在方向：从坐标换到数组。先按下标点出像素，再从数组的形状读出图的宽和高，最后把<wiki-ref to="opencv"></wiki-ref>给出的尺寸写成数组形状；OpenCV 把尺寸写成 (宽, 高)。每一问都要点中那一格或写对那两个数。
t.en: What is new is the direction: from coordinates to arrays. Pick a pixel by its index, read an image's width and height off its array shape, then write as an array shape a size given by <wiki-ref to="opencv"></wiki-ref>, which writes sizes as (width, height). Each task wants the right cell or the right two numbers.

brief.zh: 点出数组元素 I[1, 2] 所在的像素。
brief.en: Pick the pixel that holds the array element I[1, 2].

brief.zh: 这张图的数组形状是 (2, 3)：写出它的宽和高。
brief.en: This image's array shape is (2, 3): write its width and height.

brief.zh: OpenCV 说这张图的尺寸是 (4, 5)：写出它的数组形状。
brief.en: OpenCV gives this image's size as (4, 5): write its array shape.

hint.zh: 数组的形状先写哪一维？OpenCV 的尺寸先写哪一维？
hint.en: Which dimension does an array shape list first? Which does an OpenCV size list first?
